sources.title: GitHub - Srujan29112001/Clinical-AI-copilot
sources.snippet: An enterprise-grade healthcare AI system for real-time neurological disorder detection. The system fuses EEG signal analysis with clinical knowledge retrieval (GraphRAG) and large language model reasoning to deliver accurate diagnosis and evidence-based treatment recommendations -- all within a HIPAA-compliant infrastructure.
